items.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Beat Earnings Estimates, Is The Stock Still Trading At A Discount?
items.summary: Kraft Heinz (KHC) has become a focus for investors after reporting Q2 2026 adjusted earnings of $0.56 per share, which topped estimates despite weaker organic sales and a tighter full year outlook.
